event.summary: Upload credit priority loses its end-to-end regression check
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513. TLDR: the test suite no longer detects upload acknowledgements being routed behind a busy terminal, a regression that could stall uploads even while the host remains healthy. Details: deletion hunk @@ -1547,315 +1445,6 removes an_ack_arrives_ahead_of_a_backlog_of_terminal_output without a grid replacement. Its exact deletion rationale says: 'on a grid stream the flood never reached the peer in this shape, and porting the measurement is a follow-up.' Suggested fix: restore a grid-capable end-to-end check or independently exercise the real upload routing plus strict writer selection using bounded queues; retain a premise proving there is terminal backlog. Suggested bucket: other, a confirmed regression-coverage loss in maintainer tooling; no present product ordering bug is claimed. Confidence: confirmed by source only, no execution. proposed_drop: false. possible_cover: none known; no queue/coverage metadata searched. event.detail: Reviewed commit: 647f0227b7f5b6c5fe443b2d5f0c4a20de0d5513.
